Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Blinkit's Christmas home section - a festive banner strip below the category icons auto-rotates between gift art, "MERRY CHRISTMAS" lettering, and sponsor strips, in sync with the search bar's cycling placeholder text.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Blinkit's home screen reskinned for Christmas: deep green header ("Blinkit in 6 minutes", location row), a search bar whose placeholder cycles through seasonal hints ("rice", "cookies", "sweets", "disposables"), a row of category icons, then a full-width festive banner strip that rotates between a pile of illustrated gifts, a "MERRY CHRISTMAS" hand-lettered panel, and a "POWERED BY" sponsor strip. Below: a grid of red category cards (Trees & Decor, Kids Corner, Gifting Corner, Themed Parties, DIY Baking Essentials, Cakes & Chocolates) and a "Ready for Secret Santa?" footer banner.

## Motion spec
Pattern: synced auto-rotating banner with placeholder typewriter, ~3s per beat.
- The search placeholder erases and retypes to the next word every ~3s (typewriter, 40ms per character, blinking caret).
- On each placeholder change, the banner strip slides to its next panel (400ms, ease-out): gifts illustration, then "MERRY CHRISTMAS" lettering with a subtle scale-in (spring stiffness 300 damping 20), then the sponsor strip.
- Small decorative accents on the banner (stars, sparkles) twinkle on a 1.2s staggered loop.
- The category grid and footer stay static; only the search placeholder and banner strip animate.

## Calibration
- The banner rotation and the placeholder swap land on the same beat - that sync is the charm.
- Panels cycle in a fixed loop with no pause state.

## Reduced motion
Banner crossfades; placeholder swaps without typewriter.

## Don't miss
- The green/red Christmas palette reskins the whole header, not just the banner.
- The banner strip is full-bleed between the icon row and the category grid.
